source_clause: ICE11.1) If the Mode hard control is pressed the user will be moved to the next mode available in the loop (Face > Face/Feet > Feet > Feet/Windshield > Windshield), the user will be shifted with each press, press and hold of the control will only move one mode over, it will not continue to move through modes. When the Mode hard control is pressed, if the user is on Climate main the new mode button will be shown highlighted. if the user is not on Climate main when pressing the Mode hard control a small pop -up will appear above the Climate main category control (timeout after 3 seconds of inactivity or as soon as another button except Mode HC is pressed), the user will not be shifted to climate main. In both cases the main category label will be updated. While in Rear Climate screen the Mode Hard Control button will alter the front Mode.
reasoning: 驗證目標：16.12.1（ICE11.1）以十句定出 Mode 硬鍵之循環、長按行為、於 Climate main 內外之呈現差異、pop-up 之逾時，以及後排畫面下之作用，十個 037 leaf 逐句對應。關鍵情境條件：EMEA 軸取正向值；依 **R-C34** 第九軸與第十三軸暴露 → 全數補。**R-C40 之一問已於生成前作答**：其 ch2 對造 `2.12.2`（C13.1）之循環為「Face > Face/Feet > Feet > **Feet plus Windshield > then repeat loop / Defrost will not be included**」（**四模式**），而 ICE11.1 為「Face > Face/Feet > Feet > Feet/Windshield > **Windshield**」（**五模式**）—— **兩者非逐字相同**，R-C40 前件不成立，其差異恰落在 DR #31 所治之處（4 模式之適用條件），故 ch2 側之停下不轉移。為什麼這樣切：`118-02`／`118-04`（Climate main 內外之兩種情形）為同一觸發之兩個分支，其呈現差異可獨立失效。刻意略過：**`118-09` 之後排畫面** —— 其可觀察量為**前排**模式（條文明寫 alters the front Mode），故不涉「車輛是否配備後排氣候」之未登記軸；該軸之問題在於**觀察後排**，本條觀察前排（與批次 9 之 `015-04`／`015-05` 之分野）。

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: Mode 硬鍵之循環、Climate main 內外之呈現與其 pop-up
interface_axis_review.axis_9: 暴露 → 全數補；`-260` 之 pop-up 雖為 6.3 之例外，惟其位置以 Climate main category control 為錨（該錨在 comfort section 內），故仍補
interface_axis_review.axis_12: 不暴露 —— ch16 十八節無 tab 條文
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（出處 2.14 C15，跨節取據 R-C29）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: **不適用（反向）** —— 本節屬 ch16，取**正向**軸值 PC（出處 16.2）

tcs.tc_title: Mode hard control steps through the five mode loop
tcs.test_item:
ICE11.1) If the Mode hard control is pressed the user will be moved to the next mode available in the loop (Face > Face/Feet > Feet > Feet/Windshield > Windshield), the user will be shifted with each press, press and hold of the control will only move one mode over, it will not continue to move through modes.

(press the Mode hard control four times, reading the mode after each press)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Select the Face airflow mode on the climate screen
2. Press the Mode hard control four times, reading the mode after each press
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Face airflow mode is active
2. The modes were Face/Feet, then Feet, then Feet/Windshield, then Windshield
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.test_item_authored: If the Mode hard control is pressed the user shall be moved to the next mode available in the loop: Face, Face/Feet, Feet, Feet/Windshield, Windshield

tcs.tc_title: The mode pop-up times out after three seconds
tcs.test_item:
When the Mode hard control is pressed, if the user is on Climate main the new mode button will be shown highlighted. if the user is not on Climate main when pressing the Mode hard control a small pop -up will appear above the Climate main category control (timeout after 3 seconds of inactivity or as soon as another button except Mode HC is pressed), the user will not be shifted to climate main.

(wait 3 seconds without further interaction)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:

2. Wait 3 seconds without further interaction

2. The pop-up is no longer shown
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.split_reason: §8.2.2 之拆分，依 75 §1 之判準（**條文列舉之項即拆分之維度**）：本節之條文逐字列舉其觸發 —— 「timeout after 3 seconds of inactivity or as soon as another button except Mode HC is pressed」—— 故一觸發一條。兩個關閉途徑各自可失效：逾時關得掉而按他鍵關不掉，是一種失效。 （**判準之反面**：條文以泛稱表述而由作者挑樣者不拆，其樣本為 interaction data，§4.5。）
tcs.test_item_authored: The pop-up shall time out after 3 seconds of inactivity or as soon as another button except Mode HC is pressed
